员工在新的会计软件接受培训后，将有能力独立工作 -------。
A. 独立的
B. 独立地
C. 不独立性
D. 独立性

items.question: Once staff has had training in the new accounting software, they will be prepared to work -------.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“independently”代入题干后为“Once staff has had training in the new accounting software, they will be prepared to work independently.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（independently）。
